title: Health platform: Withings measurement ingestion
description: Fetch Withings measurement groups for weight, body composition, blood pressure, and pulse; persist every exact response envelope before parsing; support bounded historical sync through the generic runner's project-owned 72-hour overlap and watermark; preserve vendor IDs, pagination, timestamps, timezone, measurement type, unit/exponent, and grpid. Adapt only the narrow RPC, schema, and fixture seams from Open Wearables commit 802862fa1ac08f165a897cb9adc4f4b312b08e5c with MIT attribution.
